name: Archive Manager
description: Browse, preview and extract ZIP, 7z and TAR archives, and create new ones, with password support
help: Open or drop an archive to browse it like a folder: ZIP, 7z, TAR and tar.gz / tar.bz2 / tar.xz / tar.zst are supported, as well as single .gz, .bz2, .xz and .zst files. The format is detected from the content, not the extension.
Click a file to preview text or images. Tick files and folders to extract only those, or extract everything. By default a new folder named after the archive is created next to it.
Entries with unsafe paths (containing .. or starting at the root) are never written, and symbolic links inside archives are skipped, so an archive cannot place files outside the destination folder.
Encrypted ZIP (AES and legacy ZipCrypto) and 7z archives ask for the password when needed.

On the Create tab, add files and folders and choose ZIP, 7z, tar.gz or tar.xz. ZIP and 7z can be protected with an AES-256 password; Windows Explorer cannot open AES-encrypted ZIP files, but 7-Zip and this tool can. .DS_Store, Thumbs.db and similar files are skipped.
Everything is done in Rust without external tools.
